Paint WHITE over BOTH COMPLETE black shoes, including every toe/upper rim/sidewall/outsole/heel, and the actual small original dark wood receiver touching each shoe. Select each WHOLE shoe plus its short soft original floor-contact shade as one connected white region. No unpainted dark shoe seam or excluded thin line. The selected wood should stay tight to the original source shadow, roughly 8–20px beyond soles where real shadow exists, not a distant ellipse or hard triangular floor wedge. Let the selection feather SOFTLY into the original colored floor over the outer 8px; no hard drawn polygon edge. White shoe interiors remain fully white. The near/front shoe's left-facing sloped dark edge near x865..940,y825..880 must be inside the white selected region, never an excluded moat.
Also paint a small white irregular local linen receiver immediately below the seated skirt/blazer at x1180,y584, with a short soft outer feather. No whole cushion strip. All other pixels remain original colored: girl above shoes, socks, notebook/pencil, curtains, lamp, table, plants, furniture, empty linen, rug and unrelated floor. Only the actual shoes and tight receiving contact are marked. This is selection only, no new RGB girl, no geometry change, no text, no crop, no transparency. Exact1536×1024.
